defects.claim: Trial clock hooks call useSyncExternalStore without a server snapshot, so React server rendering throws even when the instrument has no clock
defects.scenario: Server-render a lab whose instrument has no clock; useSyncExternalStore throws before the hook can return null

defects.claim: An infinite held time on a non-seekable looping clock makes runTo loop forever and block the thread
defects.scenario: HeldClock forwards at=Infinity; the iteration budget starts at Infinity and stays there when decremented, and a looping clock never pauses at a terminal pass or reaches Infinity
defects.cause: iteration budget derived from an unbounded target

defects.claim: toggle uses the playing value captured when the control was made, so two toggles before a rerender repeat play or pause instead of undoing each other
defects.scenario: An imperative consumer holding the exported control calls toggle twice before React publishes a fresh control; the first call already changed clock.rate, and the second repeats it
defects.cause: stale playing snapshot instead of reading live clock.rate
